I would assume that you would not be able to travel to the "Portal Worlds" or the reality in which the Ways exist.  My Assumption is based on how I understand travelling to work and my understanding of those realities. 

Travelling is done differently for Saidar and Saidin, however, they both involve the Pattern (Saidar makes a sameness between two points in the pattern and Saidin bores a hole in the Pattern from one spot to the other).  However, the "Portal Worlds" were described as other worlds based on descisions and outcomes different from the primary world.  As such one must assume that they would be part of their own Pattern. 

The ways were grown and are described as like a living thing.  As such I would assume that they are part of the pattern, but more akin to a thread within the Pattern than as a place within it.  One could travel to a place in the Pattern, but not with in a person with out destroying the thread.



Just my two cp
